name: CPEI U12 Open Curling Championship
description:
Mar. 5-7, 2027 @ West Prince Curling Club

Competitors must be 11 years of age or younger on December 31 of the year prior to the competition.

Teams can be made up of any combination of males and females but must consist of no less than 4 players.

Please ensure coaches have completed their membership [here] (https://pe.curling.io/en/products/11071-2026-27-coach-membership).

Communications will be sent to one team contact, as listed in the registration form, the team contact is responsible for sharing the information with the entire team.
